content.title: Netflix’s $72 billion Warner Bros deal faces skepticism over YouTube rivalry claim
content.summary: Netflix says it must acquire Warner Bros Discovery to compete with YouTube, but antitrust experts doubt regulators will buy that argument.  The streaming giant’s $72 billion takeover of Warner Bros Discovery’s studios and HBO Max will face scrutiny from ​U.S. and global regulators, given its scale and the combined 428 million subscribers.  Netflix insists the deal is needed to challenge Alphabet’s YouTube, ‌which media analysis firm Nielsen ranks as America’s most-watched TV distributor.

content.title: Caleres Q3 profit plunges on margin pressure
content.summary: American footwear company Caleres has reported higher third-quarter (Q3) sales but a steep drop in profitability, as margin pressure, higher operating expenses and dilution from its Stuart Weitzman acquisition offset strength in its core brands.

content.title: Tapestry (TPR) Stock Trades Down, Here Is Why
